neighbours.label: social pressure and awkward social situations (conformity, avoiding upsetting topics, not pressing someone)
fire: Most people find it hard to disagree with a group, even when the group is clearly wrong.
She changed the subject quickly, because nobody at dinner wanted to talk about the divorce.
In the famous obedience study, volunteers kept pressing the button because the experimenter told them to.
He noticed she was uncomfortable, so he decided not to ask her anything more about it.
Teenagers often go along with their friends simply to avoid being left out.
Some jokes are fine among friends but would be very rude in certain company.
We tend to keep quiet about our doubts when everyone around us seems so sure.
It felt awkward to refuse the invitation in front of the whole office.
quiet: Most people find it hard to solve the puzzle, even when the answer is clearly printed.
She changed the tire quickly, because nobody in the car wanted to wait for the tow truck.
In the famous pea plant study, the monk kept crossing the plants to track their colours.
He noticed the soup was cold, so he decided to heat it up again on the stove.
Teenagers often grow several centimetres in a single year during puberty.
Some spices are fine in small amounts but would be very strong in larger doses.
We tend to keep our bikes in the garage when the weather turns cold.
It took an hour to print the report for the whole office.
